name: zmath_mat_extract_euler_angles
description: zMath::MatExtractEulerAngles extracts pitch, yaw, and roll from a 4x3 matrix.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this math helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zMath source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x474e10 validates MatExtractYaw, pitch extraction from matrix->zy and horizontal Z-axis length, basis flattening through Vec3RotateY and Vec3RotateX, roll extraction, and the yy-negative pi-minus-roll adjustment.
The native zMath smoke verifies identity extraction and round-tripping a matrix built from non-zero Euler angles.
